source_name: MNB Statisztika – Pénzforgalmi adatok (payment data topic hub)
why_relevant: Top-level hub of the MNB statistics portal for all payment-flow statistics: quarterly payment releases, settlement-system data, account package costs, and 2001-2013 archive sets. Entry point to every downstream card/ATM/POS table.

source_name: MNB Tájékoztató – Pénzforgalom (quarterly payment statistical release, HU)
why_relevant: The single densest primary dataset for the cell: quarterly time series on number of payment cards (retail/business, virtual, mobile-wallet tokenised), ATMs, POS terminals, acceptance points, payment accounts, issuer/acquirer turnover, payment fraud and payment-service revenues.

source_name: MNB Statistics – Statistical release: Payments (English mirror)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the quarterly payments release; same indicators (cards, ATMs, POS terminals, accounts, acceptance points, issuer/acquirer turnover, fraud, revenues) with English column labels — lowers parsing/translation cost for downstream analysis.

source_name: MNB Statistics – Payment systems topic hub (EN)
why_relevant: English navigation node for all payment-system statistics; useful for discovering new sub-releases and for stable English slugs.

source_name: MNB Pénzforgalmi adatközlések (payment data releases index)
why_relevant: Index page splitting the payment releases into the payment-turnover release and the payment/securities settlement-systems (VIBER, BKR, KELER) release; the reliable place to detect new releases.

source_name: MNB Fizetési rendszer jelentés (Payment Systems Report, HU annual)
why_relevant: Annual flagship analytical report (since 2014) on Hungarian payment turnover, card acceptance, POS/ATM network development, instant payments, fees and oversight risk; contains chart-backing tables and MNB's own market interpretation.

source_name: MNB Payment Systems Report (English annual)
why_relevant: English edition of the flagship payments report — the citable version for international briefings; 2025 edition published as PDF.

source_name: MNB Pénzforgalom – Kiadványok (payments publications index)
why_relevant: Curated list of MNB payment publications: Payment Systems Report, the 'Pénzforgalom 2030' strategy with its Payment Development Index, MNB-tanulmányok on household payment habits (MT143, MT98), MNB-szemle articles on fees and instant payments. Rich snowball surface for analytical sources.

source_name: MNB – Forgalomban levő bankjegyek (banknotes in circulation)
why_relevant: Official denomination-level information on banknotes currently in circulation; the anchor page of MNB's cash (készpénz) domain, used together with balance-sheet currency-in-circulation data for cash-usage analysis.

source_name: MNB – Bankjegy és érmegyártás (banknote and coin production)
why_relevant: Describes MNB's cash issuance/processing activity: minting volumes, banknote processing and destruction, denomination supply decisions — leading indicators of cash demand and of cash-handling equipment demand.

source_name: MNB Statisztika – Tájékoztató: Magyar Nemzeti Bank (central bank balance sheet, currency in circulation)
why_relevant: Monthly MNB balance-sheet statistics carry the authoritative 'forgalomban lévő készpénz' (currency in circulation) series — the numeric backbone of any cash-usage trend for Hungary.

source_name: MNB Statisztikai publikációs naptár (statistical release calendar)
why_relevant: Pre-announced release dates for every MNB statistical publication, including the quarterly payments release — lets the collector schedule fetches instead of polling blindly.

source_name: MNB Statisztika – Módszertanok (methodology notes)
why_relevant: Methodological descriptions (incl. time-series and monthly-data conventions, breaks, revisions) required to read the payment and cash tables correctly and to avoid false trend breaks.

source_name: MNB Publikációs fogalomtár (statistical glossary)
why_relevant: Official HU definitions of POS, ATM, fizetési számla, elfogadóhely, visszaélés etc. — the authoritative glossary for building the Hungarian payments terminology map used across the whole workstream.

source_name: MNB Sajtóközlemények (press releases, by year)
why_relevant: Quarterly payment-statistics press releases and cash-circulation announcements arrive here first, often with the headline numbers and MNB commentary before the workbooks are parsed; year-indexed archives give a clean back-catalogue.

source_name: MNB Éves jelentés (Annual Report – cash and payments chapters)
why_relevant: The Annual Report carries the year-end cash-in-circulation figures, cash logistics activity and payment-oversight summary; it is the audited, citable annual anchor for cash-usage numbers.

source_name: MNB Statisztika – Pénzforgalmi archív tartalmak (2001-2013 archive)
why_relevant: Historic HU payment series discontinued in the current release: chip-migration data, card business-line statistics, card-fraud cases, interbank system turnover 2002-2010. Essential for long-run POS/ATM and card penetration back-series.

source_name: MNB – Számlacsomagok költségei (account package cost comparison data)
why_relevant: Quarterly MNB dataset on the cost of bank account packages by customer profile — the pricing-side complement to volume statistics, and a proxy for competitive dynamics in HU retail payments.

source_name: MNB Szemle / MNB-tanulmányok research on Hungarian cash demand and payment habits
why_relevant: MNB research output (e.g. analysis of the change in Hungarian cash demand; MT143 household payment habits 2020) explains the drivers behind the headline cash and card series — hoarding vs transactional demand, demographic split of card use.

source_name: ECB Data Portal – Payments Statistics (PTT: ATM, OTC and POS terminal transactions), Hungary series
why_relevant: MNB reports Hungarian payment/card/ATM/POS data to the ECB under the payment statistics regulation; the ECB portal re-publishes it in a machine-readable, cross-country-comparable form with a stable API — the best structured mirror of the MNB primary tables.

source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (Institution Finder / market participants register)
why_relevant: Master searchable register of every financial organisation holding an MNB licence or registered by the MNB (banks, e-money issuers, payment institutions, AISP/PISP, intermediaries). It is the definitive index of who exists in HU banking/payments and therefore who else publishes data; the anchor for actor-map snowballing for POS/ATM/card ecosystem players.

source_name: MNB Piaci szereplők keresése / Market participants (supervision portal hub)
why_relevant: Hub page linking all MNB register surfaces (market participants search, intermediaries search, cross-border service providers, other information). Best single entry point for enumerating which registers exist and their EN mirrors.

source_name: MNB — Számlainformációs és fizetés-kezdeményezési szolgáltatást nyújtó pénzforgalmi szolgáltatók (AISP/PISP TPP list)
why_relevant: The PSD2 third-party-provider list for Hungary: names every registered AISP and PISP (e.g. KBOSS.hu, Billingo, Nyíltbankolás Zrt., Aggreg8, Recash, Koin, PSC CEE). Direct feed into the fintech/payments actor map and a leading indicator of open-banking market structure.

source_name: MNB — Számlavezető pénzforgalmi szolgáltatók adatai (ASPSP list, open banking)
why_relevant: Enumerates every account-servicing payment service provider (ASPSP) in Hungary with their open-banking interface/contact data — i.e. the full list of account-holding banks and credit institutions. Search result indicated a June 2026 update, so it is actively maintained.

source_name: MNB — Pénzforgalmi intézmény (payment institution licensing section)
why_relevant: Defines the payment-institution licence categories and links the licensing guides; needed to interpret register entries (which licence permits acquiring, money remittance, e-money, etc.) and thus to filter registers down to POS/acquiring-relevant actors.

source_name: MNB — Elektronikuspénz-kibocsátó intézmény (e-money institution licensing section)
why_relevant: Companion category to payment institutions; e-money issuers are card/prepaid and wallet players relevant to card statistics and cash-substitution analysis. Licensing guides here explain what an EMI may do in HU.

source_name: MNB — Hungarian cross-border service providers register
why_relevant: Lists Hungarian payment/e-money institutions passporting services abroad — reveals which HU payment actors are regionally expansive (relevant when sizing HU-headquartered PSPs vs. inbound EEA players).
